source_text: In patre et matre non contaminabitur. Perfectus amat supra carnem. Qui non odit patrem…
pass_a_gloss: For father and mother not he-will-be-defiled. Perfect loves above flesh. Who not hates father…
pass_b_english: He shall [[not defile himself for father or mother >> Bible:Leviticus 21:11]]. The perfect love above flesh. [[Who does not hate father… >> Bible:Luke 14:26]].
